app.name: Water Sources Management Platform
app.tagline: Monitoring sources, pumping, storage and water balance

auth.signInSubtitle: Use the email and password issued to you by Water Management.

errors.generic: Could not sign in. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: The system is not connected to its database yet. Contact the administrator.

pending.title: Your account is awaiting activation
pending.subtitle: You are signed in as {email}.
pending.body: You cannot view or enter data until an administrator activates your account and assigns your role, areas or measurement points. Contact Water Management.

setup.title: Setup incomplete
setup.body: Supabase keys are not configured. Copy .env.example to .env.local, fill in the values and restart.

saeer.gapWarning: Incomplete data: {missing} measurement points did not report. The figures below are a floor, not a final answer.
saeer.noOfftakeMeters: No route take-off meters are read daily, so the whole difference is shown as unexplained.

entry.title: Daily entry
entry.subtitle: Enter the volume in cubic metres for the operational day shown.
entry.allDone: Every point has been entered for this day.
entry.noTasks: No measurement points are assigned to you.
entry.volumeHelp: The total volume for the period, not a flow rate.
entry.cumulativeIndexHelp: Optional. Used for an independent cross-check later.
entry.recentEmpty: No previous readings for this point.
entry.savedFlagged: Saved and flagged for review because it is far from the usual range. It was not rejected or altered.
entry.correcting: Correcting an earlier reading. The old reading is kept, never deleted.
entry.alreadyEntered: A reading already exists for this day. A correction creates a new row.

errors.volumeRequired: Enter the volume in cubic metres
errors.basisRequired: Choose how the number was obtained
errors.periodReversed: The end date is before the start date
errors.periodInFuture: A reading cannot cover a future day
errors.periodTooLong: The covered period is too long
errors.pumpHoursRequired: Enter the pump hours, since that is the basis of the number
errors.alreadyEntered: An active reading already exists for that day on this point
errors.periodOverlaps: The period overlaps another reading on this point
errors.notPermitted: You do not have permission to enter readings on this point
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the reading. Please try again.

errors.title: Could not load the data
errors.migrationMissing: The database is missing a migration. Apply the latest files in supabase/migrations and retry.
errors.notPermitted: You do not have permission to view this data.
errors.queryFailed: The query failed. This does not mean the values are zero.
errors.zoneMissing: The balance zone is missing from the database.

asset.title: Assets
asset.name: Name
asset.codeHelp: Latin letters, digits and dashes only. A code is a stable identifier, not a label.
asset.coordinatesHelp: Optional. Leave empty when unknown — an empty coordinate is truer than an invented one, and the list shows it as a dash.
asset.noCoordinatesNotice: This asset has no coordinates. It will not appear on the map until a location is entered.
asset.geometryHelp: Capacity and height together, or neither. Without both, computed storage stays empty instead of invented.
asset.isPassThrough: Pass-through tank (water in is pumped straight on)
asset.isPassThroughHelp: Enables the daily inlet/outlet comparison and its mismatch alert.
asset.pointsHelp: Readings attach to the point, never to a meter, so the series survives a meter swap.
asset.noPoints: No measurement points on this asset.
asset.expectsDailyReadingHelp: When on, the point appears in the morning task list and counts towards daily completeness. Turn it off for monthly billing meters.
asset.pathsHelp: Topology is data: connecting a new well to the main is an entry here, not a code change.
asset.noPaths: No paths connected to this asset.
asset.pathNoCandidates: There is no other asset to connect to yet.
asset.connectionTypeHelp: For example PIPELINE or TRANSMISSION_MAIN. Free text, because topology is data.
asset.retireDateHelp: Must not precede the in-service date.
asset.retireExplainer: There is no delete. Retiring keeps the row and its {count} readings and only records an end date.
asset.placeholderTitle: This is a seeded placeholder row
asset.placeholderHint: Change the code and name to the real data. Editing keeps every reading attached; creating a new row would not.
asset.placeholdersSubtitle: Everything the seed created with a temporary code, so it cannot become production data by accident.
asset.placeholdersRemaining: {assets} assets and {points} measurement points still carry temporary codes
asset.placeholdersHowTo: Open each row and change its code and name to the real data.
asset.placeholdersWithReadings: {count} of these already carry readings. Renaming keeps them; creating a new row would detach them from the series.
asset.placeholdersDoneBody: Every asset and measurement point carries a real code.
asset.placeholdersOpenTitle: {count} assets still carry a temporary code
asset.placeholdersOpenBody: Replace them with real data before relying on any report.
asset.placeholderPointsHelp: Edited from the asset page they belong to.

errors.codeFormat: A code accepts Latin letters, digits and dashes only
errors.codeTaken: That code already belongs to another asset
errors.coordinatePair: Enter both longitude and latitude, or leave both empty
errors.supplyTypeRequired: A source must state where its water comes from
errors.supplyTypeNotAllowed: This asset type does not carry a water source
errors.capacityPositive: Capacity must be greater than zero
errors.heightPositive: Height must be greater than zero
errors.geometryPair: Enter capacity and height together, or leave both empty
errors.tolerancePositive: The threshold must be between zero and one hundred
errors.pointNeedsHost: A measurement point must sit on an asset or a water path
errors.pathEndpointRequired: Choose both ends of the path
errors.pathSelfLoop: An asset cannot connect to itself
errors.pathPeriodReversed: The end date is before the start date
errors.retireStatus: That status is not valid for retirement
errors.constraintViolated: The values violate a database constraint
errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

asset.pointEditKeepsReadings: This point carries {count} readings. Editing the code and name here keeps every one of them; creating a new point would detach them.
asset.externalReferenceHelp: The well or connection number as recorded by the water authority, for example 16-11/011. Never used as the code.
asset.excludedFromBalanceHelp: Measured upstream of a storage tank, so the same water is counted again at the tank inlet. Its daily reading is still required, but it may not join any balance zone.
